title: Oozy Mediterranean Fish Stew
description: A malty, gooey, and comforting Mediterranean dish featuring fish stock and air-fried ingredients, perfect for a sick day. This dairy-free-friendly stew is made with a variety of vegetables and fish.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional 1 minute.
Add the chopped bell pepper and cook until tender, about 5 minutes.
Add the fish stock, tomato paste, lemon juice, paprika, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook for 10 minutes.
Add the cod fillets to the pot and cook until cooked through, about 5 minutes.
Use an air fryer to cook the cod fillets until golden brown, if desired.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with fresh parsley or dill.
Refrigerate or freeze the stew for later use.
